CANONICAL_NAME.value: cJSON 1.7.18 -- an ultralightweight JSON parser in ANSI C (Dave Gamble et al.)

value.lineage: Single-file recursive-descent JSON parser (2009-) used in embedded and IoT code; the defensive half of the fuzzing PAIR with radamsa-0.6: fed mutated inputs under AddressSanitizer, it must reject or parse, never crash. cJSON's own history includes CVEs found by exactly this pressure (e.g. CVE-2019-11834), which is why the pair is instructive.

value.built_to: turn untrusted text into a tree or refuse it, on small machines
value.pressure: malformed, truncated, deeply nested and hostile input; tiny memory budgets
value.success_means: every input either parses to a well-formed tree or returns NULL; no memory error

value.failure_condition: a crafted input reads or writes out of bounds (the CVE history)

ANCESTRY.value: Single-file recursive-descent JSON parser (2009-) used in embedded and IoT code; the defensive half of the fuzzing PAIR with radamsa-0.6: fed mutated inputs under AddressSanitizer, it must reject or parse, never crash. cJSON's own history includes CVEs found by exactly this pressure (e.g. CVE-2019-11834), which is why the pair is instructive.

cut.note: a recursive-descent JSON reader whose defensive form is the mechanism: every byte access goes through a bounds predicate on a (content, length, offset, depth) buffer, nesting is capped by a constant, strings are measured before allocation, numbers are copied into a bounded local buffer before strtod; a parse failure frees the partial tree and returns NULL; the fuzzing history (CVE-2019-11834 and others) is why each check exists

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.human_name: parse_buffer {content, length, offset, depth}; can_access_at_index / cannot_access_at_index / can_read; parse_value (1325-1380); parse_array / parse_object depth check (1459, 1619) against CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT
organs.mechanism: parse_value dispatches on the first byte (null/false/true by strncmp after a can_read check; string on a quote; number on '-' or a digit; array on '['; object on '{'); arrays and objects increment a depth counter and refuse beyond the limit (default 1000) before recursing; every read of buffer_at_offset is guarded by an offset-vs-length predicate; the top-level parser optionally requires the buffer to end after the value
organs.output: a tree or NULL with an error position
assumptions: input is hostile; the cost of a predicate per byte is acceptable
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: a parser that can be fuzzed to completion without crashing, in one C file
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the depth limit turns a stack overflow into a parse error; the history (the record names CVE-2019-11834) is the list of places a check was missing
organs.human_prior: recursive descent (any JSON reader); the bounded-buffer discipline is the 1.7 rewrite's
organs.source_boundary: the parse_* family and the buffer predicates

organs.human_name: parse_string (781-910): the measuring loop (skipped_bytes), allocation_length, the decode loop, utf16_literal_to_utf8 (660)
organs.mechanism: first pass walks to the closing quote counting backslash escapes (and failing if a backslash is the last byte); the output is allocated once at the measured upper bound; second pass copies bytes and decodes escapes, with \u sequences converted from UTF-16 (surrogate pairs) to UTF-8 by a helper that returns 0 on a malformed pair; on failure the partial output is freed and the error position recorded
organs.input: a quoted literal in the buffer
assumptions: measuring first is cheaper than growing; an over-estimate by the escape count is acceptable
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: no realloc, no overflow: the length is known before writing

organs.human_name: parse_number (307-383): number_c_string[64], get_decimal_point, strtod, INT_MAX/INT_MIN saturation
organs.mechanism: up to 63 bytes of the number's character class (digits, sign, e/E, '.') are copied into a stack buffer, '.' replaced by the C locale's decimal point (so strtod works under any locale), NUL-terminated (the input need not be NUL-terminated), converted by strtod; no progress means a parse error; the integer field saturates at INT_MAX/INT_MIN rather than overflowing
assumptions: 63 characters suffice for any number worth parsing (longer numbers are silently truncated: a known limitation)
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: locale-proof and length-proof numeric parsing with the C library's converter
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: a 64+ character number parses as its prefix without error

rejected_cuts.candidate: the printer (print_value / print_object / ensure with its doubling buffer), cJSON_Utils.c (JSON Pointer, Patch, Merge Patch, sorting), the item construction and lookup API, hooks, the unity test framework
the doubly linked child list with head->prev = tail (1697)

rejected_cuts.evidence: the bounded-buffer discipline, the two-pass string and the bounded number are separable defences; a grammar-only parser has none of them

pressures.source_evidence: cJSON.c parse_* family; the record's fuzzing pair with radamsa-0.6
pressures.condition: an organism reads untrusted bytes into a tree; inputs include truncated, over-nested, escape-broken and locale-varying forms; a crash or out-of-bounds read is the failure; valid inputs must parse in linear time and bounded stack
pressures.resource_or_constraint: stack depth; one allocation per node
pressures.failure_condition: any out-of-bounds access, unbounded recursion or leak on failure
pressures.world_punishes: reading past the length; recursing without a cap; allocating before measuring
pressures.world_rewards: per-access bounds predicates; a depth constant; measure-then-allocate
pressures.observable_consequence: crashes and sanitizer reports per million mutated inputs (the radamsa pair), and parse time vs input size on valid documents
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: rejecting everything (which the valid-input score punishes)
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given a validity oracle must accept exactly the valid inputs at zero crashes; the 1.7 parser with the depth check removed must crash on a 100,000-deep array: the world must show both

ancestry_edges.note: PAIR: pressure generator <-> defended parser (humans regarded fuzzing as the corrective for parser bugs)
